decisions.reason: As a standalone product page since launch, this dental-adjacent product reflects visible investment and public commitment, so management is likely to continue it unless there is unmistakable evidence of persistent failure.
This product also had its own page and appears close to the firm's materials-processing capabilities, which increases sunk-cost attachment and makes withdrawal within a year less likely.

Because it was only mentioned rather than prominently featured, commitment is weaker and it is easier to cut, but management would still tend to give it more time and blame mediocre results on temporary market factors.

Although less visibly promoted than A or B, it survived while a related earmold line was already removed, suggesting the firm has selected this variant to back and is likely to persist with it for now.
